what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Venezuela in Germany: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5254 Venezuelan asylum seekers in Germany, 0.4% of all asylum seekers from Venezuela.
Refugees from Venezuela, a separate group, live mostly in Spain, Brazil, the United States and Mexico.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Venezuela, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2006 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 5639, at the end of 2024, and was slightly lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Germany only.
